scope: Actual shell commands executed in this run. Checker subprocess argument lists and actual outputs are in the per-draft checker-executions/stdout/stderr files. Two pairs of independent read commands were launched concurrently; indices are the recording order.

commands.command:
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
Get-Content -LiteralPath '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v1\skills\edu-writing\references\qualitative-narrative.md' -Encoding UTF8 -Raw
Get-Content -LiteralPath '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\variants\v1\skills\edu-shared\references\integrity.md' -Encoding UTF8 -Raw
Get-Content -LiteralPath '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\inputs\D-L02\source-pack.md' -Encoding UTF8 -Raw

[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$runPath = '<EXPERIMENT_ROOT>\runs\D-L02-new-r1-v1'
Copy-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'draft-03.md') -Destination (Join-Path $runPath 'final.md')
$draftHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'draft-03.md') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$finalHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runPath 'final.md') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($draftHash -ne $finalHash) { throw 'Final copy differs from selected draft.' }
$selection = [ordered]@{ selected_draft = 'draft-03.md'; final = 'final.md'; sha256 = $finalHash; identical = $true; body_word_count = 407 }
$selectionJson = $selection | ConvertTo-Json
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $runPath 'final-selection.json'), $selectionJson + [Environment]::NewLine, [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
$selectionJson
Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $runPath -File | Select-Object Name, Length
